back_blocks.md: Customer loyalty is when **existing customers buy products repeatedly** from the same business.

front_blocks.md: Why is it usually cheaper for a business to keep existing customers rather than gain new ones?

back_blocks.md: It is usually cheaper for a business to keep existing customers because **gaining new customers often requires expensive advertising campaigns**, while keeping current customers may only need loyalty cards or similar incentives.
